verityvisuals.menu.title: Verity Visuals
verityvisuals.feature.block_outline.desc: Highlight the block you are looking at.
verityvisuals.feature.china_hat.descript: A cosmetic cone above your head in third person.
verityvisuals.feature.inventory_hud.desc: Show useful inventory and player information.
verityvisuals.feature.fullbright.descrip: Brighten dark areas with client-side rendering.
Adjust the thickness of the targeted block outline.
verityvisuals.setting.outline_color.tool: Cycle through the available outline colors.
verityvisuals.setting.hat_size.tooltip: Adjust the radius of the hat cone.
verityvisuals.setting.hat_height.tooltip: Adjust the height of the hat cone.
verityvisuals.setting.hat_opacity.toolti: Adjust how transparent the hat appears.
verityvisuals.setting.hat_color.tooltip: Cycle through the available hat colors.
verityvisuals.setting.hud_scale.tooltip: Drag the slider to resize the HUD. Changes apply immediately.
verityvisuals.setting.hud_color.tooltip: Cycle through the available HUD text colors.
verityvisuals.setting.hud_armor.tooltip: Show armor items and their remaining durability.
verityvisuals.setting.hud_effects.toolti: Show active effects and their remaining duration.
verityvisuals.setting.hud_vitals.tooltip: Show your current health and food level.
Show the selected item and its durability.
verityvisuals.setting.brightness_intensi: Drag to adjust the extra client-side lightmap brightness.
verityvisuals.setting.element_scale.tool: Adjust the size of this HUD module independently.
verityvisuals.hud.module.inventory.descr: Player vitals, armor, hotbar, effects and selected item.
verityvisuals.hud.module.performance.des: Show client frame rate and server latency.
verityvisuals.hud.module.keystrokes.desc: Show movement and jump key states.
verityvisuals.hud.module.cps.description: Count attack actions during the last second.
verityvisuals.hud.module.armor_status.de: Show remaining durability for equipped armor.
Show active effects and remaining time.
verityvisuals.hud.module.health_food.des: Show your health and food level.
verityvisuals.hud.module.target_info.des: Show the name and health of the entity under your crosshair.
verityvisuals.hud.module.direction.descr: Show the cardinal direction you are facing.
verityvisuals.hud_editor.title: HUD editor
verityvisuals.hud_editor.hint: Drag enabled HUD elements to reposition them.
verityvisuals.hud_editor.drag: Edit each element's size and color below. Dragging is available in the HUD editor.
verityvisuals.effects.duration.tooltip: Choose how long the visual effect remains visible.
verityvisuals.effects.intensity.tooltip: Set the maximum opacity of the hit indicator.
verityvisuals.effects.description: Effects are local visual feedback and do not change game mechanics.
verityvisuals.settings.menu_scale.toolti: Resize the menu without changing the HUD scale.
verityvisuals.settings.transparency.tool: Adjust the opacity of the menu panel.
verityvisuals.settings.animation.tooltip: Reduce or increase the duration and motion of menu animations.
verityvisuals.settings.reset_hint: Restore built-in defaults. This action requires confirmation.
verityvisuals.waypoint.name: Name
verityvisuals.autoswap.not_in_hotbar: That item is not in your hotbar
verityvisuals.autoswap.key_conflict: Choose a key that is not bound to a hotbar slot
verityvisuals.autoswap.description: Press the assigned key to select the exact item ID from the 9 hotbar slots. It does nothing if the item is absent and never moves or searches main-inventory items.
